name: MPS Ltd
title: MPS Ltd - 532440 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: FY26 EBITDA INR 236 crore (30.7% margin) and FY27 guided to cross INR 300 crore EBITDA, but no capacity or capex signal; Q4 ex-AJE research margin softened and no dividend declared.

triggers.label: FY27 EBITDA above INR 300 crore
triggers.quote: the Company is expected to comfortably cross INR 300 crores in EBITDA in FY’27

triggers.label: Unbound adds ~INR 11-12 crore revenue in 50 days
triggers.quote: the revenue was in the range of INR 11 crores to INR 12 crores, and the EBITDA margin was around, I think, 18.5% to 19%

triggers.label: Pre-acceptance B2B services growth >90%
triggers.quote: we saw more than 90% growth in pre-acceptance services

triggers.label: Corporate learning revenue down 16.5% in FY26
triggers.quote: FY’26 revenue closed at INR 96 crores, down 16.5% versus FY’25

guidance.quote: the Company is expected to comfortably cross INR 300 crores in EBITDA in FY’27
probably somewhere in the 30% to 35% EBITDA range
We're expecting to go to USD 750,000 to USD 950,000 a month in FY ’27
the goal is to exit at somewhere between 25% to 30%
It is intact and in absolute line of sight.

red_flags.label: Per-client revenue declining; ex-AJE Q4 margin softened
red_flags.quote: there's some sluggishness in the Q4 margin profile

red_flags.label: AI disruption risk to commoditised production work
red_flags.quote: AI is going to super-compress the price of commoditized production work

red_flags.label: No final dividend for FY26
red_flags.quote: the Board has chosen not to recommend a final dividend

evasions.topic: Revenue split of FY27 guidance / constant currency
evasions.quote: The constant currency is not correct. So maybe we can take that off -line.
My understanding is that the headcount has been offshored to India.
